report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with mostly low latency; only one 297ms outlier. Traces show healthy downstream calls (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) with no errors, and gateway metrics show zero 502s. Memory retention is well under limit and no leak pattern is established. Current evidence does not substantiate any public cause; logs were excluded and dependency metrics are empty, so a bounded diagnosis cannot be made. Handing off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Logs for gateway/order/payment/inventory (ev-...-gw-logs excluded) to identify any error or timeout signatures
Dependency operation metrics for gateway (empty series) to attribute latency to a downstream
Per-span latency breakdown across all sampled requests to confirm whether the 297ms outlier is systematic
